chapter: Band building and learning from musicians
title: Lessons that are just talking; musicians DeVore learned from
summary: DeVore says lessons can be talk about life, and names Kid Punch, Kid Thomas, Manuel Perez and Johnny Wiggs as the trumpet men he spent most time with.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: we have Paul teaching these guys and I think he would know how to give them a legitimate approach. He would know how to give
them a jazz approach. If a guy
has an idea, would it help him to go take lessons from his idea?

Yeah, sure. I don't see why not. That's the idea I had. And a lot of times the lessons wouldn't be involved with playing the instrument at all. Just talking. Talking to them. Understanding maybe the kind of life they led. This all goes into New Orleans music. Who did you go and talk to? Well, the guys that I talked the most to are Kid Punch and Kid Thomas and Manuel Mineta and Johnny Wiggs. I think those are the four guys I spent the most amount of time with. Of the trumpet men, you know. Although Mineta teaches all instruments. And besides those men for just talking about music in general, just being around New Orleans musicians helps a guy to play better. I think because their terrific philosophy of life.
